messages:
elena: Quick heads-up — launching the On‑Prem Certification Program (pilot) today. This is a formalized readiness checklist + automated verification runner for Private/VPC/on‑prem installs.

elena: Goals: speed customer onboarding, reduce repeated security review friction, surface gaps early, and create a measurable certification badge (Bronze/Silver/Gold) for partner/customer portals.

elena: What’s included: a self-attestation form, a downloadable audit package, the cert-runner v1 (CLI + webhook results), and a standard artifact format we can hand to SOC / compliance teams. Link to doc: https://internal.redwood/certs/onprem-program (internal).

elena: Timeline: pilot customers onboard this week, general availability to new Private signups in 4 weeks. Existing customers get a 90‑day opt-in grace period.

samir: 💬 Security note — cert-runner currently checks KMS/HSM config, network egress rules, and agent attestation status. We still need to add key rotation evidence and encrypted backups check — will that be in v1.1?

elena: @samir yes — key rotation evidence is on the v1.1 roadmap. v1 focuses on structure and the most common blockers we see in customer audits.

maya: Legal/Contracts — we'll need a short addendum template for customers who share attestation artifacts. Drafting now, will ping @jay for final wording on liability clauses.

jay: On ops side — we'll add a flag to the onboarding flow so sales/solutions can require certification level before enabling Dedicated burst. Ops playbook will be updated with rerun steps if cert-runner fails.

elena: There will be two internal training sessions: Wed 10am product demo + Fri 2pm Q&A with security and solutions. Recording goes to #docs when available.

release-bot: deploy 1977659000: cert-runner v1 pushed to staging — smoke tests passed :white_check_mark:

ops-bot: Note: for pilot we will manually review all Bronze -> Silver promotions. Automation for Gold gating planned in Q3.

samir: Quick reminder — any customer artifacts we store must follow retention policy and be encrypted. Ops, please confirm storage location and TTL.

jay: Confirmed. Artifacts land in the encrypted artifacts bucket (us-east-1) with 180d TTL by default. Exceptions require SOC approval.

maya: I'll link the addendum in the onboarding checklist and share the template in the training.

elena: Action items: 1) Solutions — invite pilot customers; 2) Security — finalize v1 checks + opt-in telemetry masking; 3) Legal — addendum draft this week; 4) Ops — enable onboarding flag and update playbook.

elena: Thanks team — excited to get this into customers and reduce the manual compliance churn. Questions drop here or ping me directly. :rocket:
